responsibility: Implements the IPA pass that lowers thread-local variables to emulated TLS accesses when the target lacks native TLS support. It creates per-variable __emutls control objects and initializers, rewrites symbol-table state and alias metadata, transforms GIMPLE uses of TLS variables into calls to __emutls_get_address plus dereferences, and emits any required constructors so LTO and whole-program compilation see the emulated form early and consistently.
